name: @mcp-query/inspector
description: A flagship MCP Inspector built on mcp-query — Web Components + Vite, with a local stdio/HTTP proxy.

scripts.dev: WEB_PORT=5173 PROXY_PORT=6280 SANDBOX_PORT=5174 concurrently -n proxy,web,sandbox -c magenta,cyan,yellow "npm:dev:proxy" "npm:dev:web" "npm:dev:sandbox"
scripts.dev:restricted: WEB_PORT=5173 PROXY_PORT=6280 SANDBOX_PORT=5174 concurrently -n proxy,web,sandbox -c magenta,cyan,yellow "npm:dev:proxy:restricted" "npm:dev:web" "npm:dev:sandbox"
